items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Anyway, we had this little boy, this drummer, Lou Singer.

ctx.x: Joe Dixon played alto and clarinet. Very good clarinet player. And, after he left that band, he went with Fred Waring, you know. He was a great clarinet player. I see him every once in a while now. He lives out in Oceanside, Long Island. And, he still is a very good player. The flute and the clarinet. Anyway, we had this little boy, this drummer, Lou Singer.
